name: Congenital Neutropenia-Combined Immunodeficiency Due to MKL1 Deficiency
aliases: MKL1-Related Congenital Neutropenia with Combined Immunodeficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for MKL1 Deficiency Immunodeficiency

criteria.description: Severe congenital neutropenia with absolute neutrophil count persistently below 500 cells/μL
Evidence of combined immunodeficiency including defective T-cell and B-cell function
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the MKL1 gene
History of recurrent bacterial and viral infections starting in infancy
Laboratory evidence of impaired neutrophil phagocytosis and oxidative burst

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of severe congenital neutropenia, combined immunodeficiency, and genetic confirmation of MKL1 pathogenic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other congenital neutropenias and immunodeficiencies.

pathognomonic.notes: Persistent absolute neutrophil count <500 cells/μL from infancy
searchTerms: severe low neutrophil count from birth
very low white blood cells causing infection risk

pathognomonic.symptomName: Combined immunodeficiency with impaired T and B cell function
pathognomonic.notes: Defective adaptive immune responses leading to susceptibility to infections
searchTerms: immune system deficiency affecting T and B cells
poor immune response involving multiple cell types

pathognomonic.symptomName: Recurrent severe bacterial and viral infections
pathognomonic.notes: Frequent infections including pneumonia, otitis media, and sepsis

common.notes: Painful ulcers in the oral cavity due to neutropenia
Poor growth and weight gain in infancy
Enlarged lymph nodes due to chronic infections
Intermittent or persistent diarrhea related to immunodeficiency
Enlargement of liver and spleen due to immune dysregulation

occasional.notes: Autoimmune cytopenias or other autoimmune phenomena
Chronic respiratory infections leading to structural lung damage
searchTerms: chronic lung infections with airway damage

occasional.notes: Mild developmental delay secondary to chronic illness

rare.notes: Occasional seizures possibly related to metabolic disturbances
Rare cardiac involvement reported in severe cases
Rare tubular defects possibly related to systemic illness

laboratory: Impaired neutrophil oxidative burst and phagocytosis assays
Lymphocyte subset analysis showing combined T and B cell defects
imaging: Chest X-ray or CT showing recurrent pneumonia or bronchiectasis
other: Bone marrow biopsy showing maturation arrest of myeloid lineage

distinguishingFeatures: SCN1 caused by ELANE mutations without combined immunodeficiency
Typically isolated neutropenia without T and B cell defects
X-linked inheritance and WAS gene mutations
Combined immunodeficiency but with characteristic bleeding tendency
Associated with cardiac and urogenital anomalies
Metabolic abnormalities and glycogen storage defects

redFlags: Severe recurrent bacterial and viral infections in infancy
Persistent severe neutropenia with combined T and B cell immunodeficiency
Failure to thrive despite adequate nutrition
references: Bozek G, et al. MKL1 deficiency causes combined immunodeficiency with severe congenital neutropenia. J Clin Invest. 2018;128(5):2046-2058.
Orphanet: Congenital neutropenia-combined immunodeficiency due to MKL1 deficiency. ORPHA:619941.
